verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing describes built-in background automation: AI-powered invoice entry, approval, and payments; automated GL coding by entity; auto-enforced budget controls; and automated receipts. These are only one-line claims of pre-built automations, and the user-defined workflows shown in the evidence (Pipedream, Zapier) run on third-party platforms, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: a first-party, user-configurable automation or agent builder (triggers, schedules, actions), documentation of how autonomous background runs are set up and monitored, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
